summaryZh: Space Weather Laboratory 研究太阳物理与空间天气。官方目录链接的 Solar Group IPS 项目利用行星际闪烁资料重建太阳风密度、速度与大尺度结构，研究近地太阳风条件及扰动到达，采用运动学模型、迭代最小二乘拟合、日球层层析与航天器数据比较。

topics: IPS 项目的太阳风结构重建
近地太阳风及瞬变结构预报
methods: IPS 项目：太阳风运动学模型
IPS 项目：迭代最小二乘拟合
IPS 项目：与航天器观测资料比较

evidence.quote: Space Weather Laboratory UC San Diego researchers contribute to space, balloon, and ground-based instrumentation to study solar physics and space weather.
Space Weather Laboratory UC San Diego researchers contribute to space, balloon, and ground-based instrumentation to study solar physics and space weather

The results presented on this site represent the current status of an ongoing project in the Solar Group at A&A of a reconstruction of the global structure of the solar wind in near-real-time using interplanetary scintillation (IPS) observations received daily from the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research (ISEE), Nagoya University, Japan.
Our goal is to forecast solar wind conditions in the near-Earth environment, and predict the arrival of solar wind structures at Earth.
The reconstructions of the solar wind are based on a kinematic model of the solar wind.
An iterative least-squares algorithm is employed to obtain a 'best model' of the solar wind.
hence we call our technique 'heliospheric tomography'.
We use observations from spacecraft instruments to provide corraborative space weather data.

Our reconstruction of the solar wind aims at deriving the density and the outflow velocity in the inner heliosphere where the data coverage by the IPS observations is sufficiently high to obtain reliable results.

the Advanced Composition Explorer ( ACE ) spacecraft provides in situ velocity and density observations at the L1 Lagrange point, which can be compared with the values from our kinematic 'best model'.
